origin.description: Return a number that stays constant for a stretch of seconds.

arguments.name: current
arguments.text: Clock time. The default is the current time.

origin.details: Pass a zero-argument callable such as lambda: timeout(10) to memoise to change the cache key when the stretch ends.

translation.description: Return a number that stays constant for a stretch of seconds.

arguments.name: current
arguments.text: Clock time. The default is the current time.

translation.details: Pass a zero-argument callable such as lambda: timeout(10) to memoise to change the cache key when the stretch ends.
translation.example:
from memoise import *
print(timeout(10, current=25), timeout(10, current=30))
